evidence.clears_when: an approved canonical build for the exact weapon at party size >= 10
evidence.reason: Not valid default large-group choices: no caller sheet, published build or observation fields them at party size >= 10, and the 2026-08-19 ranged-presence rework confirmed none delivers ranged AoE via any selected spell (out/ranged_presence_report.json).
evidence.source: owner ruling 2026-08-18; re-grounded against the evidence layer 2026-08-19

battlemounts.build: Same on all: Mace or Bloodletter, offhand Aegis or Mistcaller, chest Judicator or Guardian as high tier as affordable (T9 ideal, best defence per silver), helmet Soldier or Mistwalker (Soldier = more health), Feyscale Sandals 4.4 (cheapest optimal, no real alternative; 4.3 fine).
battlemounts.status: not running them until we get better

comp_rules: Under 10: at least 1 healer, at least 1 tank; don't stack all-melee or all-range; everything approved at larger sizes is approved here.
10-man: minimum 2 healers, 3-4 tanks, rest DPS. Unusual picks genuinely work here (Primal Staff as a main is fine).

10-20 FILL ORDER: healer first, tanky support second, DPS last. Do not bring the 5th DPS while the 3rd healer slot is open — support needs grow faster than damage needs. Most common way comps go wrong.
20+: caller declares clap/kite or brawl. 6 tanks minimum, 4 healers minimum, then DPS.
Kite comps need at least 1 Occult Staff.
Brawl zergs always, always run a Carving (as pierce tank).
Kite zergs practically never run Carving — Spirit Hunter or Damnation.
Royal armor: minimum 2 Royals per 10 people for mana; can cut if there's a Chariot.
Bomb squad is a separate group, spec-gated (~100 spec floor, often the whole tree). Join when the caller asks, not because it looks fun.

gear_sets.dps_brawl: Head almost always Cleric (Soldier occasionally, Cleric just better). Chest Hellion almost always; Soldier for specific roles; Royal for mana with no Chariot. Stalker shoes for damage (Boots of Valor okay, Stalker almost always better). Smugglers 4.3, Beef Stew 8.1+, Gigantify.
gear_sets.dps_clap_kite: Head mostly Assassin for the reset, some swap to cleanse; 1 Knight Helmet; Mistwalker for melee DPS. Chest Scholar, Feyscale, Robe of Purity, or Royal Jacket. Blink shoes, sometimes Feyscale. Smugglers 4.3, Gigantify, food Beef Stew or Ava Pork Omelette — check with caller.
gear_sets.healers_brawl: Same as clap/kite except: Judicator chest, Lymhurst cape priority, offhand Shield or Blueflame Torch.
gear_sets.healers_clap_kite: Head depends on battlemounts — with Chariot at least 1 Assassin + 1 Guardian; without, at least 2 Druid Cowls. Chest Robe of Purity or Feyscale, no real alternative (Cleric Robe under 10). Blink shoes (Merc/Stalker/Cleric/Royal). Smugglers 4.3, swap Lymhurst if no Chariot. Ava Pork Omelette, Gigantify.
gear_sets.supports_not_support_tanks: Usually Occult. Assassin Hood, Royal Jacket (no swaps allowed), blink shoes, Smugglers 4.3.

legend.APPROVED: regear-eligible, but don't bring it while a CORE slot is open
legend.CORE: first choice — if you don't know what to play, play this

size_tags.bomb: bomb squad — spec-gated, not main zerg

approved: Carving Sword (fine as straight damage, but pierce tank is the better use)
dps_brawl.note: Demonfang is extremely strong right now — many brawl zergs run 2, 3, or more. Don't treat it as a niche pick.
dps_brawl.scaling: As the party grows: more of the above; possibly a Witchwork, Wailing, Permafrost, or a small kite/clap pocket for burst.

approved: Dawnsong (the one common zerg fire staff)
dps_clap_kite.requirement: at least 1 Occult Staff in kite comps
dps_clap_kite.scaling: As the party grows: add Wailing and more Rift Glaives; possibly an off-timer Spiked for extra pierce.

approved: Exalted (20+, required in some larger comps)

support_tanks_brawl.armor_split: THE RULE, not a suggestion: roughly 50/50 Hellion Hoods and Judicator Helms, leaning toward extra Hellion Hoods. Most Hellion Hood tanks run Duskweaver armor; other tanks Judicator or Guardian. Blink shoes standard, Stalker usually favored. Unsure? Cleric Cowl.
core: 1H Mace (offhand Kaitiff Shield or Astral Aegis)

support_tanks_clap_kite.armor: Head Judicator Helm or Cleric Cowl; chest Knight, Demon, or Duskweaver; blink shoes (some zergs GG Boots or Boots of Valor).
core: Bedrock Mace x2 (Guard Rune, now hits 10)
Polehammer (Groundbreaker, 20m — longest-reach hard CC in the game)

tanky_support_pierce_brawl.armor: Support tank weapons run Judicator or Demon armor almost without exception (Oathkeepers, Life Curse, Rootbound, Shadowcaller, Hoarfrost, Locus).

approved: Rootbound (midline — keeps the frontline topped, opens a retreat path)

guild_builds.scope: castle/outpost content, everything listed is regear-eligible
guild_builds.source: guild announcement — approved builds, group content

standard_kit.cape: Smugglers 4.3 always; Lymhurst on healers with no Chariot
standard_kit.fallback_helm: Melee and unsure? Cleric Cowl. Not always ideal, never wrong.
standard_kit.food: Ava Pork Omelette 7.1 default; Ava Beef Sandwich acceptable; brawl DPS run Beef Stew 8.1+; support tanks on Demon may run regular Beef Sandwich. 7.1 food / 4.3 cape is the cost-efficient line.
standard_kit.shoes: Blink shoes standard in brawl and clap, Stalker usually favored. Exceptions: healers and some tanks run Royal Shoes (NOT Sandals).

BLACKHOLE.name: Black Hole
BLACKHOLE.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9 states pull, damage and slow; nothing about reflect or duplicate behavior. Two black holes are two ground zones (baseline behavior) — likely full, not verified.

DEATHCURSE2.effect_name: Death Curse (consumes shared Vile Curse Charges)
DEATHCURSE2.name: Death Curse
DEATHCURSE2.source: Spell description @ ao-bin-dumps 5cf2e8e9: "dealing magical damage based on the amount of Vile Curse Charges on the target … (the damage cannot be reflected)". Vile Curse Charges are one pool ON THE TARGET that every curse caster feeds — duplicates accelerate the shared stack (a synergy, not a conflict; each cast's damage is its own instance).

DYNAMIC_CURSE.name: Inner Shadow

structural_reflect_statements: 5, the shadow hits all enemies within the area, dealing 144 physical damage (this damage cannot be reflected).

components.notes: strips enemy buffs in the area; duplicate-caster value unstated

structural_interrupt_statements: 5 radius around the targeted location while channeling for {1} (cannot be interrupted).
